name: Air Defender
author: G Hancox
description: ADS-B aircraft monitoring and DMX safety automation plugin for FPP.

privacy.summary: Checks a free online flight-tracking service for low aircraft near your show and closes your moving heads' shutters while one is close. Your show's location is sent to that service.

sends.what: your show's location and search radius
sends.why: to get the aircraft near your show, if you pick it or as the backup

sends.what: your show's location and search radius
sends.why: to get the aircraft flying near your show (the default service)
to look up the ground elevation there, only when you press Look it up in Settings

sends.to: http://the master FPP on your network
sends.what: a request for its status, with the master's UI password if you enter one
sends.why: so a Remote closes its heads when the master does

collects.what: callsigns, distance and height of low aircraft that passed near your show

systemChanges.what: runs a background process while FPP is running, to watch for aircraft and control the shutters

privacy.other: While an aircraft is near, or during a test, it overrides the shutter channels of the moving heads you list using FPP's channel overlays. A read-only status page on FPP's web server lets Remote FPPs check the master.
